title: A Witness for the Confession
author: Jonah Brightwater
blurb: Ivo Hartwell, an estate lawyer reading a will that shouldn't exist, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. But when the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
